leads.summary: Teronaut is a small group of electronics and engineering graduates building products in technology, electronics, robotics and aeronautics. Its site lists five projects (Agile Code, Dhatra v.2.0, Triyambaka, Tero, DeoxyLabs) without saying what they do or for whom.
leads.hook: your site lists five projects (Agile Code, Dhatra v.2.0, Triyambaka, Tero, DeoxyLabs), and the team bios mention computer-vision research
leads.angle_reason: Their only visible technical signal is Python and computer-vision research, and medvault is the Python/Django project with an LLM pipeline, the closest match to that.

leads.summary: KIOT (KIOT Innovation Pvt. Ltd.) runs a white-label IoT platform: hardware and mobile apps for home and kitchen appliances, sold to manufacturers who want smart products without building tech teams. It also offers consulting and an AI chatbot in its customer app.
leads.hook: your About page describes Product DDM, where you take manufacturers' geysers, chimneys and OTG appliances from design to a branded mobile app
leads.angle_reason: A white-label platform serving many brands needs strict per-tenant data isolation and token auth, which medvault's JWT auth and queryset-level user isolation already implement.

leads.angle_reason: No business detail on the site connects to any project; canopy is a placeholder choice only.

leads.summary: FindingPi Inc is a Nagpur and Pune firm offering digital marketing (SEO, Google Ads, social media) alongside website, web app, mobile app and UI/UX development for other businesses.
leads.hook: your services list includes web app and mobile app development alongside SEO and Google Ads
leads.angle_reason: They sell web app development to clients, and medvault is a complete web app with a Django REST backend and auth, the kind of build their clients would ask for.

leads.summary: Jombay (Yournextleap) is an HR and talent assessment SaaS: assessment centers, leadership development programs, AI-enabled engagement surveys and a candidate video-interview platform, sold to companies.
leads.hook: your Virtual Assessment Centers integrate with Taleo, Oracle, SuccessFactors and other ATS platforms
leads.angle_reason: They hold sensitive candidate and employee assessment data and advertise ISO 27001, SOC2 and GDPR compliance, the same privacy and per-user isolation problem medvault handles.

leads.summary: GeneSpectrum Life Sciences (Pune) provides bioinformatics analysis services for genomics, transcriptomics, metagenomics, epigenomics and single-cell research, plus a cloud NGS platform (GeneAssure) and a rare-variant database (RareVarDB).
leads.hook: your RareVarDB page advertises API access for integration and 20+ in-silico prediction scores per variant
leads.angle_reason: Their platforms serve clinical and research genomic data behind an API with team sharing, the same backend, auth and data-privacy design medvault implements for health records.

leads.summary: TekVision (Pune) is an accessibility company offering WCAG, Section 508 and EN 301549 audits, remediation for web, mobile and documents, and accessibility training and consulting for enterprise clients.
leads.hook: your services page covers accessibility work on React and Angular apps, not just static pages
leads.angle_reason: Accessibility audits are rule-based inspection of code and rendered output, and canopy's deterministic static analysis across languages is the closest technical parallel, though it does not check accessibility.

leads.summary: CloudYali (Pune) is a FinOps platform for engineering teams: unified cost visibility across AWS, Azure and GCP plus AI services like OpenAI and Anthropic, data platforms like Databricks and CDNs like Fastly, with automated savings and budget controls.
leads.hook: your site says you unify cost data across AWS, Azure and GCP plus OpenAI and Anthropic spend, with Databricks and Fastly included
leads.angle_reason: They normalize billing data from many providers behind one model, the same multi-provider-behind-one-interface design canopy uses across 10 languages.

leads.summary: Raven Protocol (Ravnest) builds a distributed deep-learning training framework that trains models across consumer PCs connected over the internet, with a paper and GitHub repo. Its GitHub topics also tag it web3, metaverse and gaming, so the business sits partly in crypto-adjacent territory.
leads.hook: your architecture page describes a zero-bubble asynchronous pipeline with parallel multi-ring all-reduce across consumer PCs
leads.angle_reason: Python ML infrastructure is the nearest match to medvault's Python and LLM work, but the lead is excluded as crypto-adjacent.

leads.summary: Gramiyaa is a Bengaluru D2C brand selling cold-pressed oils (groundnut, coconut, sesame, mustard, olive) through its own site and marketplaces such as Amazon, Blinkit and Zepto. Per a funding report it raised a Rs 18.65 crore Series A led by Optiscape Network Holdings; there is no posted engineering role.
leads.hook: you sell the same cold-pressed oils through your own site and several quick-commerce and marketplace channels, including Blinkit, Zepto and Instamart
leads.angle_reason: Keeping catalog, stock and orders in sync across several marketplaces is a backend API integration problem, which medvault's Django REST backend is built for.
